text:
oliver: Kicking off a tiny "linkbridge" effort for function/tool calling docs. Goal: make three very small, linkable examples so SDK READMEs and samples can reference exact code blocks. Keep examples short and copyable.

tara: Agreed. Proposal: three anchors only — #snippet-invoke, #snippet-output-schema, #snippet-parse-fallback. Use stable kebab-case ids (no hashes).

pat: I'll split the long page and add the headings. My PR will only change headings and wrap code with the Snippet component. Low-risk.

aria: I'll build the snippet wrappers and add copy buttons. We'll use <Snippet lang="ts" copy /> for TS and <Snippet lang="py" copy /> for Python.

oliver: For schema snippets, keep them minimal (required fields only) and include a short example of when a tool returns an extra field and how to shim it. Example tool payload we can show inline: { "id": 42, "result": "OK", "meta": { "duration_ms": 120 } } and then schema that expects only id and result plus a one-line shim: `const { id, result } = response; // ignore meta`.

tara: Also call out SDK invocation differences by major version with clear labels. e.g., "SDK 3.x: client.invoke({ name: 'send_email', input })" vs "SDK 4.x: client.tools.invoke('send_email', input)". Add a one-line migration note above snippets.

pat: Parse fallback note: add a short visible line under the fallback snippet: "Fallback order: strict JSON -> tolerant JSON -> regex fallback." I'll also add a tiny CLI smoke test that demonstrates a strict JSON parse failure followed by a fallback success.

ci-bot: preview available: https://deploy-preview.redwood/docs/linkbridge-invoke-4921 (CI: lint passed) :white_check_mark:.

oliver: Checklist for PRs: 1) split page into anchored snippets, 2) add snippet components with copy, 3) include minimal JSON Schema + example valid output, 4) add 1-line parse-fallback blurb + small test, 5) run page link-checker and fix detected anchors. Prefix PR titles with `docs: linkbridge invoke examples`.

aria: I'll open the snippet UI PR today.

pat: Split/anchors PR by Friday AM.

tara: Schema PR Thursday EOD with the shim example.

oliver: Great. Tag me on PRs and include a one-line changelog entry in the PR body. If we discover cross-page broken links, escalate and run the site-wide link-checker. Thanks — keep snippets concise. :thumbsup:
